description: Formats breaking out in the West that no Korean video holds yet, and those arriving. Each: what its videos do, its strongest video, how many Western videos and creators broke out with it and when last, its Korean videos so far, and how much of it needs no language. Narrow by `category` or `state`; then shorti_format(format_id).

category.description: The creator's niche, when they have one: beauty, food, fashion, daily, comedy, dance, music, pets, fitness, travel, art, gaming, product, info, ai, household, tech, parenting.

lang.description: The creator's language. 'en' answers in the English Shorti wrote: never translate its Korean yourself.

state.description: 'not_in_korea': no Korean video yet; 'arriving': the first ones; 'entered': already made in Korea.

name: shorti_trend_radar

counts.description: how many formats the radar holds in each state

refusal.description: why nothing was answered, by name

to_korea.description: the measured time from a Western hit to the first Korean video

title: Trend radar
